name: TFMFly
summary: TFMFly, or TFM-FLY, also known as DOTFM-FLY, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, amphetamine and DOx, and FLY families related to psychedelics like DOTFM and DOB-FLY.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a potent agonist at the 5HT2A serotonin receptor subtype, and is a chiral compound with the more active (R) enantiomer having a Ki of 0.12 nM at the human 5-HT2A receptor. While the fully aromatic benzodifurans such as Bromo-DragonFLY generally have higher binding affinity than saturated compounds like 2C-B-FLY, the saturated compounds have higher efficacy as agonists.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study the 5-HT2A receptor.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究5-HT2A受體的研究用化合物。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究5-HT2A受体的研究用化合物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related FLY compounds such as Bromo-DragonFLY are extremely potent and long lasting, can narrow blood vessels enough to cause tissue damage, and have caused deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的FLY化合物，例如Bromo-DragonFLY，效力極強、作用時間很長，可能使血管收縮到造成組織損傷，並已造成死亡。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的FLY化合物，例如Bromo-DragonFLY，效力极强、作用时间很长，可能使血管收缩到造成组织损伤，并已造成死亡。

fact.en: It belongs to the FLY family, named because the drawn molecule, with a ring on each side of the benzene core, looks like an insect with wings. It also carries a trifluoromethyl group, three fluorine atoms on one carbon.
fact.zh: 它屬於FLY家族，這個名稱來自分子結構圖的模樣：苯環兩側各有一個環，看起來就像一隻張開翅膀的昆蟲。它還帶有一個三氟甲基，也就是一個碳上接了三個氟原子。
fact.zhHans: 它属于FLY家族，这个名称来自分子结构图的模样：苯环两侧各有一个环，看起来就像一只张开翅膀的昆虫。它还带有一个三氟甲基，也就是一个碳上接了三个氟原子。
